question: Who explained this first-means meditation and to whom?
premises: Sri Sumatiprabhu was pleased to him.
inference: Sri Shambhunatha explained the first-means meditation, and Sri Sumatiprabhu was pleased.
uncertainties: tuṣṭastasmai may be read as dative or locative in context.
plain_english: Thus this first-means-form meditation was explained by Sri Shambhunatha; to me, Sri Sumatiprabhu was pleased to him.
